{{Quote|I am Lumiya. You were charged with developing new spy satellites for Imperial Intelligence. I am here to remind you of your loyalties to the Empire, and will overlook consorting with the enemy just this once.|Lumiya|<ref name="LDSE" />}}
An '''assault''' on the '''Epsilon Nine''' [[Communications Research Station|Communications Research]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was carried out in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] by [[Lumiya]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In exchange for military resources, Lumiya was contracted by [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Director]] [[Ysanne Isard]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] for a mission to the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] that involved inspecting the progress of several top-secret Imperial research installations. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had recently absorbed one of the Cron Drift research facilities, [[Epsilon Nine]], into its holdings, in an attempt to liberate the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] there from Imperial authority. [[Lumiya's fleet]] was engaged by the New Republic defenders upon arrival in the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]], and Lumiya released the might of her newly-restored armada to quickly neutralize the less-than-adequate New Republic opposition. She then entered the research station herself to both crush the traitor's faith in the Republic's ability to protect them and to re-exert Imperial sovereignty. Lumiya's presence was enough to elicit fear from the Imperial defectors, and the threat of deadly force sufficiently compelled Epsilon Nine's staff into reinstating their loyalty to the Empire. Certain that her instructions would not be disobeyed, Lumiya and her fleet departed Epsilon Nine with the guarantee that she would return in several months to ensure Epsilon Nine's continued cooperation.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|How could the Republic have known about this station, much less capture it?''"<br />"''Imperial Intelligence became aware of this very recently, Captain. Apparently, they have made a push into the Elrood Sector to acquire some of our technology for themselves.|Captain Valek and Lumiya|<ref name="LDSE" />}}
Although the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had been crippled by their defeat at the hands of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> many of their facilities still remained active and under Imperial operation in the months that followed;<ref name="end">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> among these were several top-secret research installations sequestered in the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]]. Knowing that the Rebel Alliance&ndash;turned&ndash;[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sought to undo the oppression by which the Empire operated throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], researchers of one particular facility in the Drift, the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]-based [[Epsilon Nine]], attempted to sever their Imperial ties by offering to work for the Republic instead. Yet, the station's employees did not know that [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agents had immediately learned of their [[Treason/Legends|treason]].<ref name="LDSE" />

[[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Diretor]] [[Ysanne Isard]] was contacted during this time by [[Lumiya]] with a request for resources following the decimation of the majority of [[Lumiya's fleet|her own fleet]] during the [[Nagai–Tof War]]. Isard committed a portion of Imperial naval strength to supplement Lumiya's ravaged fleet, though not without conditions. In exchange for her allotment, she agreed to travel to the Cron Drift on the Empire's behalf and observe the progress of the Imperial facilities and coerce them back into Imperial patronage if necessary.<ref name="tep" />

==The assault==
{{Quote|Have the corvettes assault the station's laser batteries. Helm, turn us broadside to the station, but bring the turbo-lasers to bear on those fighters. Flight Ops, launch TIE Interceptor squadron Alpha. Have TIE bomber squadron Theta support the corvettes.|Lumiya|<ref name="LDSE" />}}
[[File:Lumiya_Stormtroopers.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Stormtroopers during the infiltration of Epsilon Nine.]]
The Nebulon-B escort frigate [[Revenant (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Revenant'']] served as Lumiya's [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] as she led her fleet to the Cron Drift. She ordered ''Revenant''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Valek (captain)|Valek]] to have the fleet maintain a reduced speed and to refrain from contacting Epsilon Nine after a low-level [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] pulse originating from the [[Communications Research Station]] was discovered. Furthermore, the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] system had been reconfigured to transmit on New Republic wavelengths. The ''Revenant''{{'s}} [[scanner]]s then detected nine [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] swiftly bearing in on the fleet. Lumiya ordered the deployment of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Alpha Squadron|Alpha]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] squadron [[Theta Squadron (TIE/sa)|Theta]] in response, while also ordering for ''Revenant'' to provide [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] support. Meanwhile, the ''Revenant''{{'s}} two escort [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], ''[[Wolf-Pack]]'' and [[Borealis (CR90 corvette)|''Borealis'']], disabled Epsilon Nine's own defensive [[Laser/Legends|laser]] batteries. The X-wings were quickly destroyed by the combination of ''Revenant''{{'s}} attack and the sudden onslaught of TIE interceptors. Epsilon Nine tried to assail ''Revenant'' in futility, but ''Wolf-Pack'' and ''Borealis'' eliminated the space station's ground defenses along with the New Republic troops who manned them. Theta Squadron also ruptured an opening in Epsilon Nine's landing platform with a bombardment of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]].<ref name="LDSE" />

''Wolf-Pack'' launched two [[Assault shuttle/Legends|assault]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] carrying squads of elite [[Emperor's Royal Guard stormtrooper armor|red-armored]] [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|stormtroopers]] who were specially provisioned for Lumiya's fleet by Isard, while ''Borealis'' dropped a pair of [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut]]s onto the asteroid's surface in a direct assault of the station's central compound. The Juggernauts mowed down the opposition and created a clear pathway which allowed the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] quick access into the station. They confronted Epsilon Nine's own security forces and were even outnumbered by them, but the stormtroopers nonetheless outmatched and defeated them. With the station completely secured, Lumiya landed on the asteroid in a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] and prepared to take personal charge of the situation.<ref name="LDSE" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|My garrison will insure your diligent work&mdash;and safety. I will return in eight weeks to witness your dramatic progress. Failure will not be tolerated.|Lumiya|<ref name="LDSE" />}}
The eradication of the entire New Republic military force, with no Imperial casualties save several injuries, resulted in a total mission success in the raid on Epsilon Nine. Lumiya received this report as she entered the command center and prepared to interrogate the scientists. One particularly indignant individual had his [[Throat/Legends|throat]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Telekinesis/Legends|crushed]] by the Dark Lady after he scoffed at her for being [[Gender/Legends|female]]. She discredited the remaining scientists as traitors but offered to still pardon their insolence, and she extinguished their morale by destroying a sigil bearing the [[Insignia of the New Republic|emblem of the New Republic]] with [[Lumiya's lightwhip|her]] [[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip]]. To discourage any subsequent attempts at mutiny, Lumiya ordered that her [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] occupy the station in her absence to make certain their commitment to Imperial service remained intact. Before departing with the remainder of her fleet, Lumiya promised to return in eight weeks with expectations that the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] Epsilon Nine was originally commissioned to develop were completed.<ref name="LDSE" />

Although the New Republic had been driven from the Cron Drift and the scientists of Epsilon Nine had been forced back into loyalty to the Empire, they maintained a semblance of hope in the possibility of an eventual rescue by Republic reinforcements. The station continued its broadcast of the low-level radiation pulse that was originally detected and ignored by ''Revenant'', believing that when it reached the Cron Drift's satellite grid, New Republic operatives would detect the pulse&mdash;which was actually a distress signal&mdash;and send assistance.<ref name="LDSE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The assault on Epsilon Nine first appeared in author [[Michael Mikaelian]]'s short story ''[[Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire]]'', written for [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 3|''Star Wars Galaxy Magazine'' 3]] and published in [[1995]] by [[Topps]]. An explanation for Lumiya's acquisition of Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and Royal Guards (red-armored stormtroopers) from Ysanne Isard is given in [[Abel G. Peña]]'s [[2006]] online supplement for [[Star Wars Insider 88|''Star Wars Insider'' 88]], titled ''[[Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties]]''. Details of Lumiya and Isard's relationship are further discussed in Lumiya's entry in an article written by [[Juan Schwartz]], [[Pablo Hidalgo]], and Abel G. Peña for [[Star Wars Gamer 5|''Star Wars Gamer'' 5]], titled ''[[The Emperor's Pawns]]''.<ref name="tep" />

In ''Dark Star of the Empire'', Lumiya makes reference to the New Republic attempting to confiscate Imperial technology being developed in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] of space as her fleet approaches the Cron Drift.<ref name="LDSE" /> In other [[canon]] sources, however, the Drift itself is located in the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Whether Lumiya was speaking of other Imperial installations or a mistake was made on the author's part has not been clarified thus far, and ''Dark Star of the Empire'' makes no further mention about the Elrood sector.<ref name="LDSE" />

The assault on Epsilon Nine is depicted on the galactic map "The New Republic Advances (4-6 ABY)" of the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' as a circle centered around the neighboring [[Adega system/Legends|Ossus system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
